## Install
Paste this into Terminal:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rikenpatel02/notchbar/main/install.sh | bash
```

It downloads this release, verifies its checksum, installs NotchBar into Applications and opens it, with no security prompts. Run it again later to update.

Requires macOS 13 or later. Runs on Apple Silicon and Intel.

<details>
<summary>Prefer the DMG?</summary>

1. Download **NotchBar-x.y.z.dmg** below, open it and drag **NotchBar** onto **Applications**.
2. Open NotchBar from Applications.

This build isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS may say *"Apple could not verify NotchBar is free of malware"*. Click **Done**, open **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, click **Open Anyway** next to NotchBar and confirm. The disk image includes **If NotchBar won't open**, a picture guide to these steps.
</details>

On first launch, a setup window walks you through connecting Claude Code, Open at login and Terminal tab jumping.
